turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, plus the new delivery address.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

Thank you. Order SC-5209 has already shipped and was marked delivered on 18 November. The address can only be changed before shipping, so I can't change it. I've passed your request to a colleague, who will take over and look at what can be done. I have noted the new address, Lindenweg 9, Graz.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer (verified, cressida.paunelu@example.com) says order SC-5209 was delivered on 2026-11-18 to the old flat (Lindenweg 6, Graz) and asks to change the delivery address to Lindenweg 9, Graz. Policy: address change only before shipping, so not allowed (already shipped). Needs staff decision on how to help.
